name: Ahijah
bio: Ahijah was the son of Ahitub, brother of Ichabod, grandson of Phinehas, and great-grandson of Eli — a priest of the LORD at Shiloh at the time, wearing the ephod and present with Saul's army. On the day Jonathan and his armor-bearer secretly raided the Philistine garrison, Ahijah was there with Saul at Gibeah (1 Samuel 14:3). As confusion and uproar grew in the Philistine camp because of Jonathan's raid, Saul told Ahijah to bring the ark of God so he could inquire of the LORD, but with the battle pressing urgently, Saul soon told him to withdraw his hand and led the army out to fight instead (1 Samuel 14:18-19). Ahijah's presence shows that even on the battlefield in Saul's early reign, seeking the LORD through the priest and the ark remained an important spiritual part of Israel's military actions.
